title: Light duty use clips, novelty item is fun and giftable, just not super practical; not enough grip
text:
Light duty use clips, novelty item is fun and giftable, just not super practical; not enough grip. Cute clips, they look like real chips. The cardboard packaging is designed to look like a bag of chips. I love the overall look of these, and I think they would be a fun addition to a themed gift. Say, a bag of chips, salsa, a cute bowl, these clips, maybe some tequila.. you get the idea.

However, I think these clips are whimsical and more of a novelty than a practical, sturdy clip. Despite that, they will clip to a bag and hold it closed so long as it is not too thick, too loose, or need to have depth in terms of how far the clip reached. These clips don't have much oomph. They seem weak. These clips do fine with something simply folded over, or any bag that doesn't need a strong grip to hold it closed. I can not trust the staying/holding power of these clips. If you have one item carefully placed somewhere that just needed to be lightly secured, then ok. But if you have bags of snacks, all with clips to keep them closed and piled on top of each other, these clips will be knocked off. A clothes pin has stronger grip. So for that, I can't recommend.
